# A planner that shows a draft first

Date: 2026-11-09. Written by the planner after brainstorm question 6.

## 1. Intent
The user gets a first draft before any question.

## 6. Open risks
- How wrong the first draft may be. Worse if: users stop correcting it. Decides: the operator, question 4.
- How long a draft takes to write. Worse if: the model is slow. Decides: later tuning.
- What a draft holds when the idea is one line. Worse if: the draft is empty. Decides: the operator (question 6).

## 7. Foreseen units
- One unit.
